charged_contract: Use the observed historical first row with unchanged muon normalization, semileptonic amplitudes and source corrections. Keep all three light amplitudes; displayed central phases may be chosen real by rephasing this single row.

proton.experiment: 2018 Qweak; PVES fit, not the fit including atomic parity violation

caesium.extractor: Spin-independent amplitude, 2012 atomic PNC reduction; not claimed to be the only available atomic calculation.

precision: Quadrature of the separately quoted errors of each extraction and its historical SM baseline used only as a working width, not as a joint likelihood. The minimax criterion is for a forecast assuming zero central deviations, distinct from the historical observed offsets.
